Definition: from G3796; late; feminine (as noun) afternoon (early eve) or nightfall (later eve):--even(-ing, (-tide)).
BiblicalUsage: Evening is the hour of the crowds coming to Jesus. When the even was come, they brought unto Him many that were possessed with devils, and He cast out the spirits with His word and healed all that were sick.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe evening was when the needy came: they waited until the day was over, and Jesus healed them all the same.
